partner_result.applied_as: Exact product Choquet mixture inserted into the interval inequality after smooth cap-preserving approximation of each indicator extreme.

new_results: QFORM-CAP1-CINF-APPROX-v1: every admissible one-dimensional density admits L1 approximation by C_c^infinity probability densities preserving 0<=f<=1.
QFORM-SMOOTH-CLASS-EXACT-v1: the optimal full QFORM density constant equals exactly the optimal constant on smooth compactly supported cap-one marginals.

QFORM-SMOOTH-INPUT-C0-v1: every smooth compactly supported joint input and rank>=3 symmetric quadratic form has a bounded continuous output density via an instance-dependent L1 characteristic-function bound.
unresolved_implication: Prove a universal interval-density bound on the exact smooth subclass with constants independent of support, input derivatives/smoothness norms, dimension, orientation, and small unprotected nonzero eigenvalues.
next_step: Use the smooth exact reduction to seek an integrated Fourier or geometric inequality depending only on the cap-one normalization and the three protected large eigenvalues; do not use law-uniform pointwise quadratic decay.
